updateFeature1.message: Custom Keyboard Shortcut: Save or undo videos instantly anywhere using a customizable hotkey (Alt + W by default).

updateFeature2.message: Configurable Undo Timer: Choose between Off, 10s, 15s, or custom duration (1–60s) to fit your flow.

updateFeature3.message: Shorts & Feed Reliability: Cleaner transitions when switching Shorts and improved card injection on dynamic feeds.
